models.description: System-wide configuration settings that store application-wide settings and preferences. This table provides a flexible key-value store for various configuration parameters that can be adjusted without requiring code changes or deployments.
models.name: todo_configurations

plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier used to reference the setting in application code.
plainFields.name: key

plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string. Can contain JSON data for complex configuration objects.
plainFields.name: value

plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration setting controls.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Configuration type indicating if this is a string, number, boolean, or JSON configuration value.
plainFields.name: type

plainFields.description: Whether this is a system-level configuration that cannot be modified by users. Defaults to true for critical settings.
plainFields.name: is_system

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was initially created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft deleted. Null if the configuration is active.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: Registered users with comprehensive authentication fields supporting password reset, account security, and multi-factor authentication. Each user account is associated with a unique email address and encrypted password hash for secure authentication.
models.name: todo_users

plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all registered users.
plainFields.name: email

plainFields.description: Encrypted password hash for secure authentication using industry-standard hashing algorithms.
plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.description: Security token for password reset requests. Generated when user requests password reset, valid for 30 minutes as specified in requirements.
plainFields.name: reset_password_token

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires. Used to enforce the 30-minute token validity requirement.
plainFields.name: reset_password_expires

plainFields.description: Security token for multi-factor authentication setup and verification. Enables 2FA functionality as mentioned in requirements analysis.
plainFields.name: mfa_secret

plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for this user account. Defaults to false for new accounts.
plainFields.name: mfa_enabled

plainFields.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts. Used to implement account lockout after 5 failed attempts as specified in security requirements.
plainFields.name: failed_login_attempts

plainFields.description: Timestamp when account lockout expires after failed login attempts. Implements time-based account recovery for security protection.
plainFields.name: locked_until

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Automatically set on registration.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated. Automatically updated on any account changes.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft deleted. Null if the account is active. Enables account recovery without data loss.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: User session tracking for authentication and audit purposes. Each session represents a logged-in user's current session with connection metadata.

foreignFields.description: The user's {@link todo_users.id} who owns this session.
foreignFields.name: todo_user_id

models.name: todo_user_sessions

plainFields.description: IP address of the user's connection.
plainFields.name: ip

plainFields.description: Connection URL when the session was created.
plainFields.name: href

plainFields.description: Referrer URL when the session was created.
plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Null if the session is still active.
plainFields.name: expired_at

models.description: Guest users who can access basic functionality without registration. Guests provide temporary access to demonstrate the service's value proposition.
models.name: todo_guests

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest access was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest access was last updated.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest access was soft deleted. Null if the guest access is active.
plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: Guest session tracking for temporary authentication. Each session represents a guest user's current session with connection metadata for audit purposes.

foreignFields.description: The guest user's {@link todo_guests.id} who owns this session.
foreignFields.name: todo_guest_id

models.name: todo_guest_sessions

plainFields.description: IP address of the guest's connection.
plainFields.name: ip

plainFields.description: Connection URL when the session was created.
plainFields.name: href

plainFields.description: Referrer URL when the session was created.
plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires. Null if the session is still active.
plainFields.name: expired_at

models.description: Individual todo tasks that users can create, complete, and manage. Each task represents a single unit of work that can be completed and tracked over time. Tasks are associated with users and support simple completion status tracking.

foreignFields.description: User who created and owns this task. References {\link todo_users.id}
foreignFields.name: todo_user_id

models.name: todo_tasks

plainFields.description: Task description content up to 500 characters. Users can edit this to modify what the task involves.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Completion status of the task. False indicates incomplete, true indicates completed.
plainFields.name: completed

plainFields.description: Business workflow status of the task. Values: pending, processing, completed. Required for workflow management as specified in requirements.
plainFields.name: business_status

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was created. Automatically set when task is first added.
plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was last modified. Updated automatically on any change to the task.
plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was marked as completed. Only set when task transitions to completed state.
plainFields.name: completed_at
